title: Addiction and Freedom
definition: Addiction and freedom addresses the bondage of enslaving desires, habits, or substances and the freedom found through Christ, truth, repentance, discipleship, and the Spirit's power.
summary: Addiction is not beyond the reach of God's grace. Freedom requires honesty, support, repentance, perseverance, renewed identity, and dependence on Christ.
christFocus: Christ breaks chains, restores lives, and gives new identity to those who trust Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Addiction is not beyond the reach of God's grace. Freedom requires honesty, support, repentance, perseverance, renewed identity, and dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
